body.name: Minimum-cost identifying intervention
body.construction: Under the recursive semi-Markovian, proxy-intervention, and positive-compatible semantic scope, an intervention set \(A\subseteq V^{-}\) is feasible exactly when \(Q_s=Q[\{s\}]\) is identifiable from the acquired law \(Q[V\setminus A]=P(V\setminus A\mid\operatorname{do}(A))\). By the hedge-hitting identification lemma, this feasible class is exactly \(\{A\subseteq V^{-}:A\cap R\neq\varnothing\text{ for every }R\in\mathcal C(G,s)\}\). Choose \(A^\star\in\arg\min_{A\subseteq V^{-}}\sum_{v\in A}c(v)\) over this common feasible class; its value is \(\operatorname{OPT}(G,s,c)\).
